adapter.name: b0-oracle
adapter.description: A ceiling for today's mechanisms, not shipped behaviour: the same store lookups called once per content word of the question, every source searched, and every meeting treated as attached. Hits sharing no word with the question are dropped and the rest are ranked by word overlap (the measure Phase 43 uses), ties in source order.

embedder_details.note: the model the app embeds documents with; scored with in-memory exact cosine, which ranks identically to pgvector's cosine distance on normalised vectors (checked against PostgresDocumentStore in an opt-in test)

read_side_effects.note: MemoryStore.recall writes last_accessed on every read; the store fingerprint excludes it. A retrieval path that must be read-only (shadow mode) needs a read that does not stamp.
